subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce our upcoming team building event scheduled for next Friday at the local park. This event will be a great opportunity for us to bond, relax, and have some fun together outside of the office setting. Please RSVP by the end of this week if you plan to attend so we can finalize the arrangements. We look forward to seeing you all there! Best regards, [Company Name] HR Team
